name: Bulgaria

elections.note: Two-round system; run-off if no candidate wins a majority.

leaders: President Iliana Iotova; Prime Minister Rumen Radev (Progressive Bulgaria)
summary: Iliana Iotova, who became president in 2026 when Rumen Radev left the office to lead a new party, is seeking a full term. A Market Links poll (13–19 Oct) puts her at 47.3% against 30.6% for Andrey Gyurov, so a run-off is likely.

parties.name: Iliana Iotova
parties.ideology: Independent, backed by Progressive Bulgaria, BSP and allies
policies: Seeks a full term as incumbent
Backed by Progressive Bulgaria, BSP–United Left, ISBG and VMRO-BND
Detailed platform not yet published in English-language sources

parties.name: Andrey Gyurov
policies: Backed by the reformist, pro-EU PP–DB alliance
Alliance campaigns on anti-corruption and judicial reform

parties.name: Kostadin Kostadinov
policies: Party opposed adoption of the euro
Critical of EU and NATO policy, favours closer ties with Russia
